map.不能直接互算，GSM 取决于纱支、密度与组织；已知经密、纬密与纱支 tex 才可: They cannot be converted directly, because GSM depends on the yarn count, the density and the weave; it can only be estimated approximately when the warp density, weft density and yarn count in tex are known.
map.取代表性样布称干重、量净尺寸算面积，GSM = 重量 / 面积；回潮会影响结果，: Take a representative sample, weigh the dry weight and measure the net dimensions to get the area, then GSM = weight / area; moisture affects the result, so weigh dry or use the standard conditioned weight.

: a piece of cloth 150 cm wide, 200 cm long and 480 g -> area = 1.5 x 2 = 3 m2 -> GSM = 480 / 3 = 160 g/m2.
